text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"No matter who steps up! No matter what 
shape I'm in!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Like hell I'd back down!! UOOOOOOHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Jungle Pocket stands proud and tall! This 
is the King of Beasts! Who cares about 
Nakayama?!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Back-to-back title achieved! Once again, 
she has proven her sheer brilliance in 
front of the world's finest!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... Like hell I'll lose... There's no 
way in hell I'm losing here...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Kris S! No Reason! Come on, what's wrong 
with you two?! You're better than this, 
ain'tcha?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I ain't gonna run or hide. The next one 
is... the real deal."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen! Whoever thinks they're 
the strongest should come fight it out in 
the year-end grand showdown.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle it right there. Who the true 
top dog is!

Jungle Pocket talked a big game and 
secured a truly decisive victory, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "We did it, partner. But—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Seriously... this might be bad... 
Uuuugh...

She crouches down on the spot. The moment 
her tension snapped, the pain must have 
rushed in all at once.

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
This might be even more serious than I 
thought...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text: First, first aid. We'll talk after that.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're... Don't tell me you went out 
of your way to...

After finishing the treatment, the three 
of us decided to talk things over.

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
We need a training facility that puts no 
strain on the toes. That is the Trainer's 
opinion, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
“—I agree. Without finding that, training 
for the Arima Kinen would be utterly 
impossible.”

Hearing the expert's opinion confirmed my 
suspicions. A specialized facility really 
is necessary.

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
I am involved in training Umamusume in 
Hokkaido. It is a full-fledged training 
facility, so we have equipment there as 
well, but...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: F-For real!? Then...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
Judging by her current symptoms, however, 
that won't be enough.

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
"Unless we have the next level of 
cutting-edge equipment, it looks like 
it'll be difficult, though..."

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
It exists in Europe. Probably in America, 
too. However...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
There might not be any facilities in this 
country that have implemented it yet...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
In fact, they don't even have them at 
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: No way... It's only found overseas...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I can't go that far, obviously. Even if I 
did, no telling if they'd let me use it."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Is this... as far as I go...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If I win the Arima Kinen, I'll stand at 
the pinnacle of the new era. Even though I 
still wanna keep running...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: DAAAAMMIT!!

Heading toward the Arima Kinen, this is a 
wall we simply must overcome.
